construct: In a Cox proportional-hazards model, the hazard ratio compares instantaneous event hazards between groups among individuals who have remained event-free up to a given time. Under the proportional-hazards assumption, that relative hazard is constant over time; it is not the same as a cumulative risk ratio.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: With proportional hazards satisfied, HR 0.70 compares instantaneous hazards and means a 30% lower instantaneous hazard in treatment among those still event-free.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: The HR does not directly determine cumulative event proportion, median event time, odds of ever having the event, or an absolute event-free percentage.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The explicit proportional-hazards assumption removes time-varying-HR ambiguity; the key does not overclaim cumulative risk reduction.
